Your organization's critical systems could be at risk! 🚨

Two new, unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances are being actively exploited. These flaws allow attackers to execute code remotely, potentially taking full control. Citrix hasn't confirmed the issues or released a fix, prompting some admins to take systems offline.

slides.body: Two unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances are currently under active exploitation. These critical flaws allow for remote code execution (RCE) and pose a significant threat to organizations using these devices. Security firm watchTowr confirmed the active attacks, though Citrix has not yet officially acknowledged the issues or released a patch. Some administrators have responded by taking their affected appliances offline to prevent potential compromise.
